title: Supply Chain Resiliency for Replacement Parts of Motorised Mobility Devices Covered Under Government Subsidy Schemes
what_it_is: Supply Chain Resiliency for Replacement Parts of Motorised Mobility Devices Covered Under Government Subsidy Schemes

sections.label: Subsidised motorised device vendors
sections.summary: SMF and ATF beneficiaries can buy subsidised motorised devices from vendors through AIC, public healthcare institutions and social service agencies, and device repair and replacement standards are not imposed on every vendor.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Finance):
sentences.text: SMF and ATF beneficiaries can purchase their subsidised motorised devices from vendors via different touch points including the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC), public healthcare institutions and social service agencies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Finance):
sentences.text: We do not impose device repairs and replacements standards on every vendor working with these touch points today.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Finance):
sentences.text: For example, all vendors appointed by AIC offer such warranties.
